fault_definitions.baseline: Unchanged baseline model with paired independent streams
fault_definitions.camera_reversal: Swap camera timestamps at sequence 40 and 41; retain sequence order
fault_definitions.lidar_dropout: Remove positive LiDAR sequence numbers divisible by 37
fault_definitions.lidar_offset: LiDAR fixed offset raised from 0.8 ms to 17 ms
fault_definitions.timing_jitter: Timestamp noise SD: camera 3.2 ms, lidar 5.5 ms, imu 0.75 ms; same standard-normal draws
fault_definitions.trajectory_bump: Add one 12–16 s half-sine position disturbance: x +0.28 m, y -0.20 m
fault_definitions.trajectory_drift: Add [0.016, -0.009, 0.0016] m/s position drift; heading unchanged

method: One fault per paired seed; independent SeedSequence streams for trajectory/camera/lidar/imu; old baseline/degraded benchmark unchanged
